summary: Minimal agent-neutral governance foundation completed. Created .governance/ directory structure with SYSTEM.md, RULES.md, SAFETY.md, and REVIEW_POLICY.md. Established tool-neutral governance contracts and safety policies for Ralph-Loop system.

Started RALPH-002A: Minimal runtime-state and handoff foundation. Creating static runtime foundation files for task state management, handoffs, runs, validation, and reporting without implementing runtime behavior.

RALPH-002A completed: Minimal runtime-state and handoff foundation. Created all required static foundation files including task-state.json, task-history.jsonl, runs/current-run.json, validation-rules.json, and morning-review.md template. JSON and JSONL validation passed, no code/runtime behavior changed.

Started RALPH-003A: Minimal agent prompt and adapter contracts. Creating static prompt templates and adapter contracts for Cline, OpenCode, Roo, and Codex. No executable adapters or loop-runner scripts - static contract foundation only.

RALPH-003A completed: Minimal agent prompt and adapter contracts. Created static prompt templates (coordinator, worker, reviewer, validator) and adapter documentation (cline, opencode, roo, codex) plus configuration files (loop-config, protected-files). JSON and JSONL validation passed, no executable adapters or runtime behavior changed.

Started RALPH-004A: Root governance transition notes. Adding minimal transition notes to root governance files (SSOK.md, AGENTS.md) and updating runtime state files. Creating transition documentation without modifying product code or scripts.

RALPH-004A completed: Root governance transition notes. Added minimal transition notes to SSOK.md and AGENTS.md explaining Ralph-Loop governance migration. Created comprehensive transition documentation in docs/RALPH_LOOP_TRANSITION_NOTES.md. Updated runtime state files. No product code or scripts changed.

Started RALPH-005A: Dry-run task selector plan. Creating comprehensive planning document for deterministic task selection algorithm. Defining CLI interface, eligibility rules, safety constraints, and implementation specifications for future dry-run selector script.

RALPH-005A completed: Dry-run task selector plan. Created comprehensive implementation plan with CLI interface, task eligibility rules, safety constraints, JSON schema definitions, and error handling specifications. Plan document provides complete implementation guide for RALPH-006A.

Started RALPH-006A: Dry-run task selector implementation. Implementing the first executable Ralph-Loop component based on RALPH-005A plan. Creating deterministic task selector script with CLI interface, safety checks, and dry-run capabilities.

RALPH-006A-FIX completed: Fixed critical execution bugs in Ralph task selector. Restored CLI execution flow (--help, --dry-run, --json, --write all produce visible output), corrected JSON/text output modes, fixed write mode behavior, and improved stale active run detection with support for both task_id and selected_task_id field names.

RALPH-006A completed: Dry-run task selector implementation finished with critical bugfix. First executable Ralph-Loop component is now fully functional with CLI interface, safety checks, and dry-run capabilities.

Started RALPH-007A: Morning review generator plan. Creating comprehensive implementation plan for the second executable Ralph-Loop component that aggregates runtime state into human-readable morning review reports.

RALPH-007A completed: Morning review generator plan. Created comprehensive implementation plan (1,200+ lines) with detailed CLI interface, aggregation rules, safety constraints, and report structure. Plan is implementation-ready for RALPH-008A.

RALPH-007A-STATE-FIX completed: Repaired missing runtime-state updates for RALPH-007A. Updated task-state.json (RALPH-006A and RALPH-007A marked done), added missing task-history events, updated validation results, and synchronized all runtime state files.

Started RALPH-008A: Morning Review Generator Implementation. Implementing the second executable Ralph-Loop component based on RALPH-007A plan. Creating deterministic morning review aggregation script with CLI interface, safety checks, and report generation capabilities.

RALPH-008A completed: Morning Review Generator Implementation. Successfully implemented the second executable Ralph-Loop component with full CLI interface (--dry-run, --json, --write), aggregation logic, safety constraints, and comprehensive report generation. All tests passed, JSON/JSONL validation successful.

Started RALPH-009A: Cline Worker Adapter Preparation. Preparing Cline as Ralph-Loop worker adapter by creating setup documentation, dry-run checklist, and implementation plan. No Cline installation or execution performed.

RALPH-009A completed: Cline Worker Adapter Preparation. Successfully created comprehensive Cline setup documentation (CLINE_RALPH_WORKER_SETUP.md), first dry-run checklist (CLINE_FIRST_DRY_RUN_CHECKLIST.md), and detailed dry-run plan (RALPH_CLINE_DRY_RUN_PLAN.md). Updated adapter documentation and runtime state. No Cline installation or product code changes performed.
